sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: Filename, type/size where relevant and upload state/error are text. Decorative media icon is explicitly hidden. Action labels include the actual attachment name; thumbnails need useful alt when conveying content.
updatesAndDescendants: Attachment state is a caller-supplied styling prop, default done; it does not upload, select files, retry, cancel or progress through states. Title/Description are spans, Content/Actions/Group are divs. AttachmentAction composes Button, ghost/icon-xs defaults. AttachmentTrigger uses native button default type=button, or an explicit native render such as anchor. Group supplies horizontal overflow/snap, not selection state. Caller owns async request transitions and focus after removal. Do not nest Trigger buttons/anchors inside other interactive elements or cover secondary actions with an unnamed trigger.
referenceDecision: The error wording, status text and Retry Button are explicit caller composition. A real async operation determines state; no synthetic timeout is attached to make the visual upload states look operational.

naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.
protocol: Source-normalized observations project real internal image/scroll state, derived progress, caller-owned upload props or the composed Collapsible protocol. No generic activation callback is invented. Internal lifecycle observations are not public Root events.
